class.name: roomba_hardware/ESP32SystemInterface
class.description: Real-hardware ros2_control SystemInterface for the roomba diff-drive base. Talks to an ESP32 over a serial link (V1/V2 velocity commands, S stop, Z zero, POS/VEL telemetry) to drive base_left_wheel_joint / base_right_wheel_joint. Velocity command interface, position + velocity state interfaces, one joint per wheel -- mirrors gz_ros2_control/GazeboSimSystem's interface shape.
